release.notes: Glow Green now uses Futura PT Bold. Glow Green and Blue Bonus normalize horizontal/vertical character scale to 100% and remove text scale animators. Blue Bonus STROKE is a native 5 px text stroke (no Layer Styles fill), retains the FFX transparency mask and stroke color, follows MAIN text styling-preserving text expression, and tracks MAIN position with a 15 px left offset.
